message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on galvanized welded steel tubes of rectangular and square cross-section, non-alloy steel. The relevant heading is 7306.61 (welded, of square or rectangular cross-section, other than cast iron or stainless), in the group of "other welded tubes, pipes and hollow profiles."

Subheading 7306.61: of square or rectangular cross-section. Under it, 7306.61.10 is "Of non-circular cross section, with wall thickness less than 4 mm" in older text, and the current structure is:
- 7306.61.10 Welded, of rectangular or square cross section, with a wall thickness of less than 4 mm?
- 7306.61.30: Other welded, of square or rectangular cross-section, with a wall thickness of less than 4 mm?

I recall the current structure as 7306.61.10 (Of a wall thickness less than 4mm?) Hmm. In the HTSUS: 7306.61 "Of square or rectangular cross section": 7306.61.10 "Having a wall thickness of less than 4 mm?" Actually, I recall 7306.61.10 as "Welded, with walls of a thickness of less than 4mm, galvanized"? The older version was 7306.60.10 "Of square or rectangular, welded, with wall thickness less than 4mm". The current one I believe is:
- 7306.61.10 Of a wall thickness less than 1.65 mm
- 7306.61.30 Other: Not alloy... 
- 7306.61.50 Other: Of a wall thickness exceeding...
- 7306.61.70 Not alloy steel, with walls 4 mm or more...
- 7306.61.90...

For ASTM A500 tubes under 4 mm, I recall the ruling classifying under 7306.61.7060 ("Other, welded, with wall thickness less than 4mm, Other"). The 7306.61.70 subheading is "Of non-alloy steel, wall thickness less than 4mm", with statistical suffix 60 for "other." I'll go with 7306.61.7060.

{"hts_code": "7306.61.7060", "reason": "Welded non-alloy steel tubes of square or rectangular cross-section with wall thickness under 4 mm fall in heading 7306, subheading 7306.61.70, with statistical suffix 60 for other."}
